aciklama: Bozuk ya da erişilemeyen paket deposu yapılandırmasını dağıtımın standart deposuna döndürür (eskisini /var/backups/filo-depo altına alır) ve depo üst verisini yeniler. Debian ve Alpine.

komut.debian:
k=$(. /etc/os-release; echo "$VERSION_CODENAME")
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/backups/filo-depo
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do [ -f "$f" ] && sudo -n mv "$f" /var/backups/filo-depo/; done
printf '%s\n' 'Types: deb' 'URIs: http://deb.debian.org/debian' "Suites: $k $k-updates" 'Components: main' 'Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg' '' 'Types: deb' 'URIs: http://deb.debian.org/debian-security' "Suites: $k-security" 'Components: main' 'Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg' | sudo -n tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources >/dev/null
sudo -n apt-get update -q >/tmp/filo-depo.log 2>&1 || { tail -5 /tmp/filo-depo.log >&2; echo depo=standart; echo guncelleme=hata; exit 1; }
echo depo=standart
echo guncelleme=tamam
komut.alpine:
v=$(cut -d. -f1,2 /etc/alpine-release)
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/backups/filo-depo
sudo -n cp /etc/apk/repositories /var/backups/filo-depo/repositories
printf '%s\n' "https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v$v/main" "https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v$v/community" | sudo -n tee /etc/apk/repositories >/dev/null
sudo -n apk update -q >/tmp/filo-depo.log 2>&1 || { tail -5 /tmp/filo-depo.log >&2; echo depo=standart; echo guncelleme=hata; exit 1; }
echo depo=standart
echo guncelleme=tamam

kuru.debian: echo '--- şu anki depo tanımları:'; cat /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | head -20; echo '--- yapılacak: standart deb.debian.org tanımı yazılacak, eskisi /var/backups/filo-depo altına alınacak, apt-get update'
kuru.alpine: echo '--- şu anki depo tanımları:'; cat /etc/apk/repositories; echo '--- yapılacak: standart dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org tanımı yazılacak, eskisi yedeklenecek, apk update'

geri_al.debian:
sudo -n rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources
for f in /var/backups/filo-depo/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in */sources.list) sudo -n mv "$f" /etc/apt/sources.list;; *) sudo -n mv "$f" /etc/apt/sources.list.d/;; esac; done
echo geri_alindi=evet
